text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection 
list I1, which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
above title block.
This pump is used to Sodium 
Hypochlorite unloading from the 
sodium hypochlorite car tank to the storage tank
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed 
El-Henawy, 
reviewed by eng. Hossam El-Din Mostafa, accepted by eng. Magdy Okba, revised by 
MDEPC 
quality control 
eng. Magdy Hegazy, and approved by eng 
Ahmad Abd El-Meguid Sowan head sector of Nubaria PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control general 
manager & MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Sodium Hypochlorite Unloading pump | 019 A/B
Manufacturer | Savino Barbera
Model &Type | OMA 40 A horizontal centrifugal pump
Number
 of Stages | 1
Speed | 2840 RPM CW
Motor power | 1.5 kw
Liquid Handled | Sodium Hypochlorite
Capacity | 9 M3/H
Head | 10 M
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask ...etc.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor
Isolate the pump 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure 
 pump must be completely drained.
Tools and 
Equipment
Supports and thicknes
Parallel v block
Hexagonal socket or elbowed wrenchs (16,23,30mm)
Wrenches (8,13,17 and 19mm)
Puller 
 for pins 3,4,6,8 mm
Bearing extractor
Pair 
 of levers
Monkey 
 wrench
Hammer
Rubber 
 hummer
Twist 
 drill 3,4,6,8 mm
Vernier slide gauge
Emery 
 cloth
Surface gauge
Work to be carried out
Pump in operation
Check pump capacity, pressure and 
 power .
Check the Noisy of the Pump.
Check pump leak
Measure vibration
Pump out of operation
Check the fixation
Adjust mechanical seal
Adjust alignment
Starting 
 the Pump
Before starting the pump, the 
 following steps should be checked
The control valve in delivery to the pump, must be partially 
open
Check the direction of rotation of motor before starting it 
 is clockwise
The on-off valve in the suction from the tank, must be 
 completely open, while the air discharge valve after complete priming - if 
 applicable - and the draining valve must be closed
The control valve in delivery to the pump, must be partially 
open
Attendance and checking during operation of the pump, the following should be 
checked:
Check of flow rate delivery 
 head and absorbed power
Follow the indication of 
 the flow - motor and manometer installed
Check 
 the 
 water leakage of pump
Check the
 pump 
 pressure
